1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d5 4.Nxe5 Qg5 5..strategy: Castles to cover g2 and lets Black take the knight, hoping to win two pawns back with exd5 while the c6 knight is pinned and Black's king sits in the centre. A knight for two pawns is too much to give, and simply retreating the knight keeps White better.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d5 4.Nxe5 Qg5 5..name: Ruy Lopez: Spanish Countergambit, Harding Countergambit, Fricke Gambit

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d5 4.Nxe5 Qg5 5..strategy: Takes the knight but walks into the point of the queen move: with the king still on e1 nothing guards g2, so ...Qxg2 attacks the rook on h1 and the queen then takes e4 with check. White ends a pawn down with a king stuck in the centre.
